direct.configuration.title: Direct DX12
direct.ui.mode.help: Vanilla disables Direct. Direct DX12 replaces supported terrain and preserves vanilla fallback. Diagnostic overlay draws terrain twice. Changes apply only after Save.
direct.ui.presets.help: Click to cycle profiles. Balanced restores default budgets. Lower memory reduces upload and memory budgets; terrain may take longer to load. Compatibility uses CPU synchronization, copied color and uncompressed textures. Profiles select terrain replacement, but do not enable Direct or change HUD/logging preferences. No FPS gain is guaranteed.
direct.ui.retry.help: Restart using saved settings and clear the automatic retry limit. Unsaved edits remain in this screen.
direct.ui.visuals.help: Open the installed Raydiance configuration. Visual effects are optional and saved separately. Direct's pending edits are kept when you return.
direct.ui.save_failed: Could not save. Your draft is kept; see latest.log.
direct.ui.pending: Unsaved changes • Save applies; Cancel/Esc discards.
direct.ui.hint: Configure terrain here; visual effects live in Raydiance.
direct.ui.diagnostic_hint: Detailed errors: logs/latest.log. Optional profiling writes direct-performance.csv and direct-translucency-performance.csv under logs. Copying this report only puts it on your clipboard.
direct.ui.guide.start: Open Direct from Mods > Direct > Config, F7 (rebindable in Controls), or /direct menu. Select Direct DX12 and Save and apply. Join a world to initialize the GPU. New installations start with vanilla rendering.
direct.ui.guide.modes: Direct replaces only terrain it can render and import successfully. Sections still loading remain vanilla. Entities and later passes retain imported depth. The diagnostic overlay renders both paths and is intended for troubleshooting, not everyday play. Replacement uses 100% of Minecraft's terrain distance.
direct.ui.guide.presets: Balanced uses default resource budgets. Lower memory caps terrain at 128 MiB with smaller upload batches; it is a memory tradeoff, not an FPS promise. Compatibility disables optional interop/recording optimizations and BC7 compression. Profiles do not change Raydiance effects. Hover controls for their cost and behavior.
direct.ui.guide.save: Edits are staged until Save and apply. Cancel or Escape discards all unsaved changes, including profiles. Renderer changes restart the backend at the next client tick; HUD and profiling changes do not rebuild it. Returning from Raydiance preserves this draft, but Raydiance saves independently.
direct.ui.guide.recovery: Vanilla remains available when Direct fails. Failures retry after 5 and 10 seconds, then suspend Direct after the third failure. Restart renderer or /direct retry requests a new attempt with saved settings. The failure counter resets after 120 successfully imported frames. Diagnostics keeps the last error for investigation.
direct.ui.guide.visuals: Raydiance is optional. Its F8 menu controls effects and Lus shaderpacks. HLSL passes are separate from the Direct terrain switch. Disabling Raydiance integration does not turn off Direct. Other terrain renderers (Sodium, Embeddium, Iris, Oculus, OptiFine) block Direct activation to avoid competing terrain pipelines.
direct.ui.guide.limits: Requires Windows x86-64, Java 21, Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.265+ and a compatible D3D12/WGL driver. Direct does not load Iris/OptiFine shaderpacks. Shadows, water and reflections retain their current near-camera/screen-space limits. This update has not been tested in game; GPU compatibility, visual correctness and performance still require validation.

direct.help.enableDx12Preview: Uses Direct for supported terrain; failures retain vanilla rendering.
direct.configuration.enableDx12Preview.t: Uses Direct for supported terrain; failures retain vanilla rendering.
direct.help.replaceVanillaTerrain: Replace supported terrain after a successful import. Off enables the diagnostic double-render overlay.
direct.configuration.replaceVanillaTerra: Replace supported terrain after a successful import. Off enables the diagnostic double-render overlay.
direct.help.showRendererStatus: Shows the current backend/fallback at the top left. Hidden with F1 and the F3 debug screen.
Shows the current backend/fallback at the top left. Hidden with F1 and the F3 debug screen.
direct.help.profileRenderer: Records FPS, frame-time percentiles and renderer costs to logs every 60 seconds. Optional; does not benchmark automatically.
direct.configuration.profileRenderer.too: Records FPS, frame-time percentiles and renderer costs to logs every 60 seconds. Optional; does not benchmark automatically.
direct.help.compressBlockAtlas: Reduces texture memory with lossy BC7 compression. May change pixel colors. Save restarts Direct and rebuilds its atlas.
Reduces texture memory with lossy BC7 compression. May change pixel colors. Save restarts Direct and rebuilds its atlas.
direct.help.preferDirectColorInterop: Avoids a color copy when WGL supports it; automatically falls back to copied color. Depth still uses a copy.
direct.configuration.preferDirectColorIn: Avoids a color copy when WGL supports it; automatically falls back to copied color. Depth still uses a copy.
direct.configuration.directBridge.toolti: With shared native color, also shares depth natively: a D3D12 depth image replaces the D3D11 depth copies, and the world stage reads OpenGL's depth without an import copy. Falls back to copied depth automatically.
direct.help.nativeSharing: How DX12 images reach OpenGL. Color and depth: both images are shared natively; depth needs no D3D11 copies and the world stage reads it without an import copy. Color: depth keeps a copied bridge. Off: both are copied (Compatibility). Each level falls back automatically when the driver rejects it.
direct.help.maxMeshUploadsPerFrame: Maximum section uploads per frame. Higher values populate terrain faster but can increase frame cost.
direct.configuration.maxMeshUploadsPerFr: Maximum section uploads per frame. Higher values populate terrain faster but can increase frame cost.
direct.help.maxMeshUploadMiBPerFrame: Soft per-frame terrain upload limit. One oversized section is still allowed.
direct.configuration.maxMeshUploadMiBPer: Soft per-frame terrain upload limit. One oversized section is still allowed.
direct.help.terrainRenderDistancePercent: Only adjustable in diagnostic overlay mode. Terrain replacement requires 100% of Minecraft's configured distance.
direct.configuration.terrainRenderDistan: Only adjustable in diagnostic overlay mode. Terrain replacement requires 100% of Minecraft's configured distance.
direct.help.useGpuSemaphoreSync: Uses shared GPU semaphores when supported. Falls back to CPU synchronization when the driver rejects them.
direct.configuration.useGpuSemaphoreSync: Uses shared GPU semaphores when supported. Falls back to CPU synchronization when the driver rejects them.
direct.help.flushOpenGlStages: Sends recorded OpenGL work to the GPU after each world render stage, so the next DX12 terrain frame does not wait behind a whole frame held until the swap. Only while DX12 terrain is active.
direct.configuration.flushOpenGlStages.t: Sends recorded OpenGL work to the GPU after each world render stage, so the next DX12 terrain frame does not wait behind a whole frame held until the swap. Only while DX12 terrain is active.
direct.help.animatedAtlasRefreshMillis: Minimum interval for animated sprite updates. Smaller values make animations smoother but increase texture traffic.
direct.configuration.animatedAtlasRefres: Minimum interval for animated sprite updates. Smaller values make animations smoother but increase texture traffic.
direct.help.cpuAtlasAnimation: Copies animated block frames into the DX12 atlas from the images Minecraft sends to OpenGL, instead of reading them back from OpenGL. Same pixels. Disable if a mod changes block textures some other way.
direct.configuration.cpuAtlasAnimation.t: Copies animated block frames into the DX12 atlas from the images Minecraft sends to OpenGL, instead of reading them back from OpenGL. Same pixels. Disable if a mod changes block textures some other way.
direct.help.bc7EncoderThreads: CPU workers for BC7 atlas compression. Fewer workers leave more CPU time for Minecraft.
direct.configuration.bc7EncoderThreads.t: CPU workers for BC7 atlas compression. Fewer workers leave more CPU time for Minecraft.
direct.help.parallelSectionRecording: Records opaque and cutout commands concurrently. Disable to reduce worker-thread use.
direct.configuration.parallelSectionReco: Records opaque and cutout commands concurrently. Disable to reduce worker-thread use.
direct.help.useExecuteIndirect: Uses D3D12 ExecuteIndirect when supported. Compatibility profile disables this optional submission path.
Uses D3D12 ExecuteIndirect when supported. Compatibility profile disables this optional submission path.
direct.help.dx12Translucency: Forces the extra translucent stage even without water/reflection effects. Off lets effects request it only when needed. Costs an additional scene transfer.
direct.configuration.dx12Translucency.to: Forces the extra translucent stage even without water/reflection effects. Off lets effects request it only when needed. Costs an additional scene transfer.
direct.help.uploadRingBufferMiB: Persistent upload capacity. Larger values use more memory and accommodate larger batches/translucent index updates.
direct.configuration.uploadRingBufferMiB: Persistent upload capacity. Larger values use more memory and accommodate larger batches/translucent index updates.
direct.help.terrainArenaPageMiB: Size of lazily allocated GPU terrain pages. Does not set the total terrain budget.
direct.configuration.terrainArenaPageMiB: Size of lazily allocated GPU terrain pages. Does not set the total terrain budget.
direct.help.maxTerrainArenaMiB: Maximum GPU memory for Direct terrain buffers, excluding textures and render targets. Pending/unavailable sections retain vanilla draws.
Maximum GPU memory for Direct terrain buffers, excluding textures and render targets. Pending/unavailable sections retain vanilla draws.
direct.help.maxPendingMeshMiB: Soft warning threshold for pending CPU meshes, not a hard process-memory limit. Never blocks the render thread.
direct.configuration.maxPendingMeshMiB.t: Soft warning threshold for pending CPU meshes, not a hard process-memory limit. Never blocks the render thread.
direct.ui.finish_first: Use Save or Cancel to finish this screen and return to the previous settings.
direct.help.maxMeshUploadMicros: Soft section-upload CPU budget per frame. At least one section progresses; zero disables the time limit. Smaller values can delay terrain loading.
direct.configuration.maxMeshUploadMicros: Soft section-upload CPU budget per frame. At least one section progresses; zero disables the time limit. Smaller values can delay terrain loading.
direct.help.maxSectionAdoptionsPerFrame: Visible sections compiled before activation that are rebuilt per frame for DX12. Vanilla draws them meanwhile. Higher values finish activation faster but load the chunk workers more.
direct.configuration.maxSectionAdoptions: Visible sections compiled before activation that are rebuilt per frame for DX12. Vanilla draws them meanwhile. Higher values finish activation faster but load the chunk workers more.
direct.help.nativeVertexPacking: Converts captured chunk meshes to Direct's vertex format in C++ on the chunk threads. The output is byte-identical to the Java converter, which remains the fallback. Off in the Compatibility profile.
direct.configuration.nativeVertexPacking: Converts captured chunk meshes to Direct's vertex format in C++ on the chunk threads. The output is byte-identical to the Java converter, which remains the fallback. Off in the Compatibility profile.
direct.help.faceCulling: Skips groups of block faces that all point away from the camera before they reach the GPU. The image is unchanged; animated wind/wave layers are never skipped. Off in the Compatibility profile.
